routing.instructions: Route this support ticket to the team that should handle it. Choose exactly one team. Rule: if the ticket shows at least two abuse warning signs (no supporting evidence attached, an account younger than 30 days, or an unusually large refund demand over USD 18,500), route to trust and safety regardless of the issue type.

criteria.billing_desk: Invoices, charges, proration, refunds of payments.
criteria.technical_desk: Product failures: errors, outages, data loss, integrations.
criteria.product_team: Purchased add-ons, seats and entitlements not delivered.
criteria.trust_and_safety: Tickets with repeated abuse warning signs needing review.

abuse_review.instructions: Should this ticket be flagged for trust & safety review before any refund is issued? Answer yes only when at least two abuse warning signs appear: no supporting evidence, an account opened within 30 days of the ticket, or a refund demand over USD 18,500.

urgency.instructions: How urgently must this ticket be worked? critical: data loss or an outage affecting the whole workspace. urgent: the customer is locked out, stuck, or lost their MFA device. priority: account-security matters or a refund over USD 8,800. routine: everything else.

refund_eligibility.instructions: Is this refund request eligible? Rules: the issue must fall inside the account's lifetime (an issue first reported before the account was opened is outside the window). An issue reported within 2 days of the account opening needs manual review. The reporting add-on is only sold on Plus or Premium plans — on Basic or Standard the purchase is voided and not refundable. Otherwise the request is eligible.

criteria.eligible: Issue inside the account window and no plan exclusion applies.
criteria.review_required_fresh_account: Issue within 2 days of account opening; review first.
criteria.not_eligible_plan_exclusion: Reporting add-on purchased on Basic/Standard (void sale).

refund_band.instructions: After the processing fee is applied, which band does the refund fall into? Fees: billing USD 25, technical USD 10, account USD 0, product team USD 50. If the request is not eligible or is held for trust & safety review, nothing is payable yet (USD 0).

criteria.zero_nothing_payable: Not eligible, needs review, or held for abuse review.
criteria.over_15000: Refund over USD 15,000 after the fee.

vendor_recovery.instructions: Should the refund be recovered from a vendor (chargeback to the payment gateway or the shipping partner)? Answer yes only when a specific vendor is identified as the cause: a gateway double charge, or a shipping-partner integration failure with request logs attached.

expected_touches.instructions: How many agent touches will this ticket need? 0-1: complete, evidenced, low-value ticket (straight-through candidate). 2: one complication - missing evidence, a refund over USD 8,800, or an eligibility check. 3: two complications. 4+: flagged for trust & safety or three complications.
